question: When going straight ahead at a roundabout, when should you signal left?
options: Just after you pass the exit before the one you want
After you have left the roundabout
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 says to signal left after passing the exit before yours.

question: When turning right at a roundabout, what should you do with your signal before leaving?
options: Keep signalling right until you are on the new road
Switch from right signal to left signal just after the exit before yours
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 states to signal left after passing the exit before your right-turn exit.

question: Who benefits most from a clear left exit signal on a roundabout?
options: Drivers waiting at the next entrance to join the roundabout
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 uses exit signals to show waiting drivers you are leaving.

question: What should you check in your mirrors just before signalling left to leave an inner roundabout lane?
options: Check your left mirror and blind spot for cars or cyclists beside you
Only look at the central island
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 tells you to watch for traffic on your left before moving out to exit.

question: What signal must you give just before leaving any roundabout?
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 requires a left signal as you prepare to leave a roundabout.

question: If you are taking the third exit, when do you switch to a left exit signal?
options: Just after passing the second exit
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 times the left signal right after passing the exit before yours.

question: Why should you NOT signal left before passing the exit before yours?
options: Drivers waiting at that earlier exit may think you are turning off and pull out
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 prevents early exit signals from misleading waiting drivers.

question: When taking the first exit to the left, what happens to your left signal?
options: Keep signalling left all the way around into the exit
Cancel it at the give-way line
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 keeps the left signal on from approach through the first exit.

question: After you have entered the exit road from a roundabout, what should you do?
options: Check your left signal has cancelled
Leave the left signal on for 300 metres
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 and Rule 103 require cancelling your signal once clear.

question: At a mini-roundabout, why can it be hard to give a separate left exit signal?
options: The junction is very small, so keep your focus on steering safely if tight
Left signals are banned at mini-roundabouts
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 and Rule 188 note there is less time to signal exit at very small mini-roundabouts.

question: You are in the right-hand lane of a two-lane roundabout and want to exit. What must you check before signalling left and moving out?
options: Your left mirror and blind spot for vehicles on your left
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 requires checking left before moving across to exit.
